description: This Java test class 'TelemetryMqttQoS0IT' contains integration tests for uploading telemetry data via MQTT protocol with QoS level 0. It extends a base test class and overrides methods for sending messages, verifying message reception ratio, waiting times, and creating message consumers. The file makes use of Vert.x testing framework, MQTT client, and specific constants related to telemetry topics.

classes.name: TelemetryMqttQoS0IT
classes.description: Integration test class for MQTT QoS 0 telemetry upload, extending MqttPublishTestBase, with customized methods for sending messages, asserting reception ratio, and creating consumers.

methods.name: isTestEnvironment
methods.description: Determines if the current environment is a test environment based on system property.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends a telemetry message to a specific MQTT topic with retry logic, using QoS 0.

methods.name: assertMessageReceivedRatio
methods.description: Asserts whether the received message count meets the expected ratio depending on environment.

methods.name: getTimeToWait
methods.description: Returns the wait time based on environment for the test duration.

methods.name: createConsumer
methods.description: Creates a telemetry message consumer via application client factory, returning a Future of MessageConsumer.
